title: Frontier Dispatch
premise: A lone frontier courier-ranger is sent out from a dispatcher hub to clear hostile globs from a supply route and eliminate the marked chief so the convoy can move safely again.
interaction_model: Real-time top-down action on a full-screen mobile-friendly canvas with left-side analog movement, right-side attack and skill buttons, and a swap button to cycle between three cooldown-based abilities.
objective: Talk to the Dispatcher, defeat five normal enemies, survive escalating pressure, and then defeat the boss to secure the route.
progression: A short quest chain gates progression from briefing to hunt to boss fight, while XP, rank-ups, gold, stronger attacks, and increased max HP provide light RPG growth during the run.
theme: Retro-futurist frontier courier combat with convoy-defense framing and arcade action.
mood: Energetic, heroic, slightly tense, and arcade-stylized with neon sci-fi polish.
likely_audience: players who enjoy light survival-RPG loops
players who like touch-friendly boss-rush-lite experiences
confidence_notes: High confidence in the basic gameplay loop because quest states, enemy spawning, win/loss logic, skills, and UI labels are explicit in code.
Moderate confidence in the exact fiction because some labels are thematic wrappers over simple arcade systems.
The game presents itself as a dispatch/courier mission, but mechanically it is a compact top-down survival-action quest.
recreation_prompt: Create a full-screen mobile-friendly top-down action game called "Frontier Dispatch" where the player controls a sci-fi ranger/courier on a neon frontier map and begins near an NPC Dispatcher who gives a short mission briefing. Use a single arena-like overworld made from simple tile terrain with a central stone plaza, water borders, scattered trees, and decorative flora. The player moves with an analog-style virtual joystick on the left half of the screen and uses large right-side buttons for a basic close-range attack, a special skill, and a swap button that cycles between three cooldown-based abilities: a forward projectile scan shot, a burst mobility skill that functions as a speed/dash boost, and a healing patch skill. Make the core loop about speaking to the Dispatcher, then surviving while defeating five roaming hostile globs that constantly spawn around the player, earning credits and XP, leveling up for more health and stronger attacks, and finally spawning a larger chief boss that must be defeated to win. Enemies should chase the player, deal contact damage, flash when hit, and show health bars; combat should produce particles, floating damage numbers, cooldown feedback, and visible HUD elements for health, cooldown status, credits, rank, and current quest text. Present everything with crisp pixel-like primitive art, neon blue and amber sci-fi UI panels, a title screen, dialogue box, win/lose modal screens, and energetic arcade audio so the overall tone feels like a retro-futurist courier mission wrapped around a short survival-action boss finale.
